description: Figure 7 presents a comparison of mBERT and XLM-RoBERTa performance across different language families. The horizontal axis displays language family categories labeled “same,” “better,” and “mBERT better,” arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “tense,” represents a value scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick marks at 5-unit intervals. Four bars are present for each language family category, with two bars representing mBERT and two representing XLM-RoBERTa, differentiated by color: mBERT bars are green, and XLM-RoBERTa bars are teal. Within each language family category, the first bar is mBERT and the second is XLM-RoBERTa. For the “same” category, the mBERT bar reaches approximately 10, while the XLM-RoBERTa bar reaches approximately 15. In the “better” category, the mBERT bar reaches approximately 12, and the XLM-RoBERTa bar reaches approximately 18. Finally, in the “mBERT better” category, the mBERT bar reaches approximately 18, and the XLM-RoBERTa bar reaches approximately 8. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
